# Absolute paths kept in the distroless image on top of the packaged files.
# These are either built from source (so no Debian package owns them) or
# generated by a maintainer script.

# CPython, xmlsec1 and libpython, all built from source in the FIPS base
/usr/local

# the compiled authentik binary and the application tree
/usr/bin/authentik
/ak-root
/authentik
/blueprints
/lifecycle
/locale
/schemas
/web
/geoip
/manage.py
/pyproject.toml
/packages

# OpenSSL: the from-source FIPS provider and its configuration.
# fips.so is installed by the fips-debian base and no package owns it.
/usr/lib/*/ossl-modules
/usr/lib/ssl
/etc/ssl

# glibc data from libc-bin, which is not in the keep list.
/usr/lib/locale

# resolver and account data written in the assemble stage
/etc/nsswitch.conf
/etc/gai.conf
/etc/hostname
/etc/localtime
/etc/passwd
/etc/group
/etc/shadow
/etc/gshadow
/etc/ld.so.conf
/etc/ld.so.conf.d
/etc/krb5.conf

# writable mount points
/certs
/data
/media
